Eight explicitly written polynomial identities imply the exact rational generating function by formal uniqueness. Coprime numerator and denominator prove a genuinely minimal degree-six recurrence. All critical finite polynomial identities and coprimality replay from verify.py; an independent direct Stern enumeration corroborates the first 18 levels, not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact dyadic modular zero-counts are a natural arithmetic invariant of a classical sequence, motivated by Reznick’s earlier distribution theorem. The new p=7 formula identifies the first notable irreducible-quartic spectral structure in the prime case beyond p=3 and proves an optimal fluctuation rate. The constructive eight-state reduction and minimality provide more than a routine finite table, while making no claim of a general new method for all moduli.
